530701.name: Ersatz Wormhole
530701.description: Fires lasers from four pseudo-wormholes, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The wormholes can be destroyed.

530705.name: Summon Wormhole
530705.description: Opens a wormhole and summons Raptures. The summoned Raptures will generate a code barrier and then proceed to self-destruct, dealing damage to a single Nikke. While the barrier is up, only Water Code Nikkes can deal damage.

530706.name: Summon Asteroids
530706.description: Opens multiple wormholes and summons asteroids. Any Nikkes who are hit will have their ATK reduced. This effect can stack. The asteroids can be intercepted.

530708.name: Interstellar Missile
530708.description:
Summons interstellar missiles, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while summoning missiles. While the barrier is up, only Water Code Nikkes can deal damage.
The missiles can be intercepted.

530715.name: Summon Wormhole
530715.description:
Opens a wormhole above itself to summon meteors before launching them at all Nikkes, dealing damage.
Gatekeeper generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while summoning meteors. While the barrier is up, only Water Code Nikkes can deal damage.

530717.name: Interstellar Missile
530717.description:
Summons interstellar missiles, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while summoning missiles. While the barrier is up, only Water Code Nikkes can deal damage.
The missiles can be intercepted.

530718.name: Supernova
530718.description:
Creates a portal into subspace and summons a supernova.
The portal must be closed via Special Interruption.
If the opening is not closed, it deals damage to all Nikkes.

The portal must be closed via Special Interruption.
If the opening is not closed, it deals damage to all Nikkes.
